_comment: This file is a pure configuration dictionary (no functions, classes, or callable APIs). It defines model settings for OCRNet with ResNet-50 backbone in MMSegmentation. No actionable tool examples apply.
review_model_config: review the OCRNet ResNet-50-d8 model configuration for semantic segmentation hyperparameters
summarize_model_config: summarize the OCRNet model config including backbone, decode heads, and data preprocessor settings
refactor_norm_cfg: refactor the SyncBN normalization config to use a different normalization type
refactor_decode_head: refactor the OCRHead decode configuration to change ocr_channels or num_classes values
refactor_backbone: refactor the ResNetV1c backbone config to adjust depth, dilations, or stride settings
